DEVELOPMENT PL AN REVIEW BO ARD
  MINUTES
  FEBRUARY 9, 2023 at 8:30 AM
  245 EAST BONITA AVENUE
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS

  BOARD MEMBERS PRESENT

  David Bratt, Planning Commission
  Scott Dilley, Chamber of Commerce
  John Sorcinelli, Public Member at Large
  Steve Barragan, Engineering Manager (Substitute for Shari Garwick)
  Henry Noh, Director of Community Development
  Eric Beilstein, Building & Safety Manager (Substitute for Brad McKinney)

  STAFF PRESENT

  Luis Torrico, Planning Manager
  Anne Nguyen, Associate Planner
  Victoria Gutierrez, Departmental Assistant

CALL TO ORDER

David Bratt called the regular meeting of the Developmental Plan Review Board to order at 8:32
a.m. so as to conduct regular business in the Council Chambers.

DPRB Case No. 21-0011
Associated Cases: ACCELA PROJ 21-0038

The Applicant, Lorry Ma, JWL Associates, Inc, is requesting to construct a new 6,333 square-foot
two-story single-family residence with a 1,639 square-foot second floor covered roof top deck and
an attached 1,100 square-foot four-car garage on an existing vacant lot. The subject property is
located at 1046 Southcliff Street within the Single-Family Hillside Zone (SF-H) and is also subject
to a Private Horse Overlay (PH) (APN: 8385-013-014).

The Applicant, JWL Associates, Inc, was present.

Associate Planner Nguyen presented the staff report and recommended the Board recommend
approval to the Planning Commission subject to the conditions of approval.

Building & Safety Manager Beilstein stated all new homes must have a solar photovoltaic
system installed as per State mandate and complemented the design of the proposed roof, but
he recommended the Applicant have the project architect consider how roof-mounted solar panels
might blend with the design.

Representative of JWL Associates, Inc stated he believes the homeowner will hire a
professional solar company to install solar panels.
 DPRB Minutes  Page 2
February 9, 2023

Mr. Sorcinelli asked if the homeowner could choose to install ground-mounted panels.

Building & Safety Manager Beilstein answered that the homeowner may be able to have a
ground or roof-mounted system as long as it complies with the mandate, but should consider the
design if they choose a roof-mounted system.

Mr. Sorcinelli noted that the project plans are only stamped by a licensed engineer and not an
architect. He also stated the drawings presented to the Board should clearly call out what is part
of the approval and what is conceptual.

Planning Manager Torrico stated that additional amenities like pools and gazebos can be
included in the conceptual drawings, which may be permitted and constructed separate from the
single-family dwelling. He stated Staff will make sure the plans are clear moving forward.

Building & Safety Manager Beilstein asked the Applicant whether the proposed stucco on the
residence will be smooth or sand-finish.

Representative of JWL Associates, Inc answered the stucco will be smooth.

Mr. Sorcinelli moved to continue the item to a meeting at a later date for reconsideration with the
following conditions after the Applicant/Developer revises the plans to specify what improvements
are solely conceptual and to be stamped by a licensed architect.

Planning Manager Torrico stated conceptual plans for landscaping, accessory structures, or
swimming pools are accepted for DPRB submittals, as they are not subject to the Board’s purview.
Upon a formal submittal to the Building & Safety Division, only those items that will be constructed
will need to be on the plans. He also reminded the Board that the item before their review today
is the single-family residence, and not the landscaping, swimming pool or accessory structures.

There was no second, the motion was not considered.

Motion DPRB Case No. 21-0011

Community Development Director Noh moved to recommend approval to the Planning
Commission with the following modifications;
  • If the plans are prepared by an architectural firm or if there is a licensed architect on staff
  with the firm preparing the plans, updated architectural plans that are stamped by a
  licensed Architect shall be submitted to the Planning and Building Division by the
  Applicant/Developer.
  • The Applicant/Developer shall ensure that as part of the installation of solar panels
  required of the new residence that the new solar panels be architecturally screened as
  appropriate (if applicable).
  • The Applicant/Developer shall submit to the Planning Division updated architectural plans
  that specifically call out “not a part” for any site and landscape improvements that are
  solely conceptual.

Motion seconded by Mr. Dilley.

Motion carried 4-1-1 (Sorcinelli opposed, Bratt abstained)
